_comment: Phase 3 config: 4 required models on NSL-KDD (binary target). Hyperparameter grids are searched on the VALIDATION set only; the test set is used once, at final evaluation. Edit and re-run scripts/train_models.py to change.
_imbalance_note: NSL-KDD binary is only mildly imbalanced (train ~53/47) but KDDTest+ is ~43/57; class_weight='balanced' is applied to every model (Keras class_weight for the LSTM). SMOTE arrays from Phase 2 remain available as an alternative.

svm_rbf._subsample_note: libsvm RBF is ~O(n^2-3); training is capped at a seeded stratified subsample. ROC-AUC uses decision_function (probability=True is not enabled - it would add slow internal CV).

lstm._seq_note: NSL-KDD has no timestamps and near-zero label autocorrelation in published file order (~62.7k label switches over 126k rows, avg run length ~2 rows). Sequences = W consecutive records in file order; window label = last record's label. Contiguous train/val split of KDDTrain+ with a W-row guard gap so no window straddles the boundary. See DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md section 10.3 for the full rationale and limitations.
lstm._framework_note: PyTorch (not TensorFlow): TF wheels compatible with the pinned numpy 1.26 require protobuf<5, which conflicts with streamlit 1.63 (needs protobuf>=5.26). PyTorch has no such conflict.
